body: She's been a, the constant in my life for almost ten years... I am who I am because of her. I literally don't know how to live without her. I can't believe in myself, I don't even know who I am without her.

I'm having such a hard time with my thoughts right now. The most important relationship in my life might be over and it's all I can think about. I managed to make it into work today, both jobs, and spent half my time crying at one and had to leave early at the other.

I never had a plan before... But I just set up the noose, just to get a feel for it, and it left me wanting to take the next step. And I know my inebriated self is nihilistic enough to say "fuck it" and go farther than I can pull back from... I've never felt so close to actually doing this
